texts.uz: Sukut boʻyicha Nightshift yaratgan hech narsa oʻzi ommaga chiqmaydi. Nashr tekshiruvidan oʻtgan tayyor video YouTube kanalingizga shaxsiy video sifatida yuklanadi. Videoni, uning ssenariysini va tekshiruv natijasini ilovada koʻrishingiz mumkin. Avtomatik nashr har bir kanal uchun alohida sozlanadi va siz yoqmaguningizcha oʻchiq turadi.
texts.ru: По умолчанию ничто из созданного в Nightshift не становится публичным само. Готовое видео, прошедшее проверку перед публикацией, загружается на ваш YouTube-канал как приватное. В приложении можно посмотреть ролик, прочитать сценарий и увидеть результат проверки. Автопубликация включается отдельно для каждого канала и выключена, пока вы её не включите.
texts.en: By default, nothing Nightshift makes goes public on its own. A finished video that passes the publish check is uploaded to your YouTube channel as private. You can watch it, read its script and see the check result in the app. Auto-publish is a switch for each channel and stays off until you turn it on.

evidence.claim: Uploads are private by default: YOUTUBE_PRIVACY defaults to private.
A channel's auto_publish column defaults to false, so a channel does not go public on its own until someone turns it on.
When the channel's auto-publish switch is off, the upload privacy is clamped to private whatever was requested.
A publish gate runs in front of an upload and can block it; it can never cause one.
The pipeline evaluates the publish gate before the upload and does not upload a blocked video.
The review panel shows the preview, the script and the gate verdict for a video.
